input.brief: MuseClone cuts any viral short video into a shot-by-shot blueprint and reshoots it around your product

direction.name: The printed annual
direction.idea: Lay the page out like a well-designed printed report or magazine feature: a masthead image, a tight oversized title, text held to a strict column line, and colour used in solid blocks the way a two-colour print job would. It gives weight and authority to subjects that are really about content: findings, a manifesto, a programme, a serious product. The reader should feel that someone edited this.
direction.composition: A fixed vertical axis at about 42% of the viewport width organises everything: headings begin on it, body columns hang from it, and the 0–42% zone holds small side notes, figures or stays empty. Masthead: a wide image band (photographic mosaic or a single crop) across the top 45% of the first screen; below it the title at 7–9vw starting on the axis, with a two-sentence standfirst at 20–24px. Sections alternate between text pages (title on the axis, body in one or two columns of 34–40ch to its right) and full-bleed colour pages carrying one large figure, quotation or image mosaic. Mosaics are gutterless: photographs and flat colour tiles butted together in a 4- or 6-cell grid. Page numbers, running heads and other print furniture are left out.
direction.typography: A tight heavy grotesk or a sharp serif for titles; an excellent text face for reading at 18–20px with leading near 1.5. Headings in sentence case, tracked tight.
direction.colour: Paper, ink and two or three solid block colours. A colour page is a whole section in one flat colour.
direction.imagery: Photographs used as blocks in mosaics alongside flat colour tiles; mixed subjects are fine if cropped tight and converted to one treatment.
direction.photoTreatment: Give all photographs in a mosaic one treatment: greyscale via `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05)`, or all full colour. Do not mix.
direction.richness: The column line, the mosaics and whole pages of colour give structure and variety without ornaments.
direction.pitfalls: The axis must be exact and reused everywhere or it reads as random indentation. Keep paragraphs to a real reading measure. On a phone the axis collapses to the left margin and side notes move inline above their paragraph.

hero.name: Two-by-two board
hero.blueprint: A board with 8px outer margins and 8px gaps throughout; every tile is a filled rectangle with one shared radius (0 or 8px). A 60px top row is itself made of tiles: a square ink tile with the logo mark, a wide ground-tone tile holding four text links that begin at the centre line, and an ink tile at the right end holding the single action. Below it the rest of the viewport is a two-by-two grid. Top-left: a paper tile with the name, or its first word, at clamp(96px, 12.5vw, 190px), medium weight, tracking -0.05em, sitting bottom-left on 24px padding. Top-right and bottom-left: photographs covering their tiles (object-fit: cover), both greyscale so they read as one picture continued across the board. Bottom-right is divided into two tiles side by side: a dark tile with one sentence at 24px, top-left aligned, and a tile in the accent colour with a second short statement at 24px, also top-left. Text never centres inside a tile. No tile is empty and none is outlined.
hero.mobile: The board becomes one column of tiles with 6px gaps: a top row with the logo tile and a menu tile; the name tile at 30% of the screen height with the name at 22vw bottom-left; one photograph tile at 4:3; then the dark tile and the accent tile side by side as two squares. The second photograph moves below the first screen.
hero.headline: The name, or its first word, up to 8 characters at 12.5vw; the two 24px statements are one sentence each.

type.note: A sturdy screen-reading serif with a large x-height; headings are simply the text face at medium weight and a larger size. Suits essays, reports, newsletters and knowledge products.

palette.name: Sheet and biro
palette.note: White holds the whole page with black type, one grey for secondary lines and a pale grey step for tiles and inputs; the footer may invert to black. Blue is the colour of text links and the one button, and nothing else is tinted.

photos.title: Fog and quiet
photos.note: misty, muted, minimal landscapes and empty horizons; calm areas for text
photos.treatment: Give all photographs in a mosaic one treatment: greyscale via `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05)`, or all full colour. Do not mix.

motion.name: Shutter image
motion.description: The one hero or showcase image opens from an edge with a clip-path over about 1.1 seconds while the picture inside settles from 1.12 scale to rest. Use it once, on the image that matters most; later images simply are there. Recipe: 'Image shutter' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Band of unequal panels
sections.blueprint: A modest heading, then one wide band of pictures. The heading, two to four words at 36–44px, starts at column 3, left of centre, with 64px beneath it. The band spans the full viewport width edge to edge and is 68svh tall: four photographs standing side by side with no gaps and deliberately unequal widths, a flex row with flex-grow values of 5, 2, 3 and 2. Each panel is cropped with object-fit: cover to a tall slice, so the band reads as one folded view. The first panel carries a two-line title at 28px in paper colour at its top-left, 24px in, over a neutral scrim that covers only that corner. Hovering a panel raises its flex-grow to 6 over 500ms while the others give way; without hover the widths simply stay. One caption line at 16px sits under the band at the left margin.
sections.mobile: The heading sits on the margin at 28px. The band becomes a two-by-two block with no gaps, 84svh tall in total: the first row split 64/36 and the second 36/64, so the slices stay unequal. The title stays on the first panel. No hover behaviour.

sections.name: Many into one
sections.blueprint: A diagram drawn with one repeated shape instead of arrows. The heading (two to four words on two lines at clamp(36px, 4vw, 60px)) and a short paragraph at 17px sit in columns 1–4. Beneath, a wide inline SVG spans columns 1–12 at about 4.5:1. It is built from 120–160 small filled squares (or the page's own motif), each 10–14px. In the left third they are scattered loosely in two pale tones. In the middle third they are pulled into a tight horizontal ribbon three squares high. In the right third they fan out again into neat, evenly spaced rows in the accent colour. The eye reads disorder, compression, order, from left to right. Under the diagram, three text columns aligned to its thirds: a bold one-word name at 20px and two lines at 16px each; the words carry the sequence ('Gather', 'Reduce', 'Release'). No connecting marks.
sections.mobile: The diagram turns to run top to bottom: a 3:4 SVG with the scatter at the top, the ribbon as a vertical band in the middle and the ordered rows at the bottom. The three names and their text sit to its right in a 38vw column, each level with its zone.

sections.name: Comparison set as text
sections.blueprint: A comparison table with no lines and no tick marks. A CSS grid: capability names in columns 1–5 of 12 at 22–24px medium, then three answer columns of equal width (plans, methods, or this against the usual way). Every cell answers in words at 17px: 'Yes, unlimited', 'Up to five', 'Not yet', never a symbol. Seven to ten rows, each 64–72px tall, with every other row on a ground one tone darker so the eye tracks across; rows touch. The column that matters is one filled block in the accent or ink colour running the full height of the table behind its cells and rising 24px above the first row, with its text reversed. Column names sit in the top row at 17px bold. The heading, two to four words at 40–48px, hangs top-left above column 1 with 48px beneath.
sections.mobile: The table turns on its side: one block per capability. The name at 20px bold, then three lines beneath, each giving a column name and its answer at 16px; the featured column's line is set on the filled colour at full width. Blocks alternate the two ground tones.

sections.name: The idea again, inverted
sections.blueprint: The close flips the page's colours: ink becomes the ground and the ground becomes the ink, across a full-bleed field at least 90svh tall. The page's opening idea returns as a headline of three to five words at 9–11vw on two lines, leading 0.9, flush left, positioned in the upper two-thirds; it should echo the hero's wording, not repeat it. Along the bottom, on one shared baseline 40px above the edge: one supporting sentence at 20px in columns 1–5 and one rectangular button in the accent colour, right-aligned in columns 10–12, about 56px tall. Nothing else: no image, no second button, no logo. The field's top edge is a hard horizontal line where it meets the section above. If the footer follows on the same inverted field, leave 160px before it so the close still reads as its own screen.
sections.mobile: The same inverted field at 80svh. Headline at 15vw on two lines at the top. The sentence sits lower at 17px, and the button spans the full width at the bottom, 56px tall, with 20px margins. Nothing else is added.

sections.name: Columns above, wordmark below
sections.blueprint: The footer inverts ground and ink and fills a whole viewport (min-height 100svh), arranged as three rows in a grid (auto 1fr auto). Top row, 40px from the edge: four small columns on the 12-column grid (address, navigation, social, hours or contact), each a plain list at 15–16px with its first line in the full ink and the rest in the softer ink. Middle row: empty. Bottom row: the wordmark alone, sized to run from the left margin to the right margin on one line. Set it as inline SVG text with a `viewBox` fitted to the word and `width: 100%`, or tune `font-size` in `vw` to the letter count, so it never wraps; its baseline sits 20px above a single line of legal text at 13px. With `position: sticky; bottom: 0` and a lower `z-index` than the page, the last section slides away to uncover it.
sections.mobile: Columns become two by two at 15px with 32px between rows, at the top. A gap of about 20svh follows. The wordmark spans the full width at the bottom; a name longer than ten letters stacks on two lines, each fitted to the width. Legal line beneath at 12px.

references.name: The Queue
references.idea: An essay on queueing where the queue is the ornament: a line of drawn figures stands along the bottom of the hero and returns between chapters in changing period dress.
references.hero: Pinkish warm-grey page. A 12px mono breadcrumb sits top-left; there is no other navigation. The two-word title is set in a light serif at 200px (14vw), centred, its middle slightly above the viewport centre, spanning about 60% of the width with tight tracking. One centred line of grey 20px serif sits 40px beneath. The lower third stays empty until a single row of about 25 small greyscale drawn figures, each around 110px tall, stands on a hairline rule 20px above the bottom edge and runs the full width like a frieze.
references.type: Newsreader does everything: Light at 200px with -0.05em tracking for the title, regular near 30px for chapter headings, 18px body with open leading, and pale ghost numerals around 22vw. A monospace appears only in the breadcrumb and footer labels.
references.colour: #ebe4e0 #2b2622 #6f6763 #d9d2ce #16a05a — One warm rosy-grey ground throughout, brown-black text, mid-grey secondary lines, greyscale drawings. A single green appears only in the breadcrumb and one footer button.
references.imagery: Hand-drawn greyscale figures with fine outlines, standing in single file on a hairline; each band changes era costume and spacing. No boxes or backgrounds: figures sit directly on the page colour, full width.
references.layout: After the centred hero, text runs in one narrow column about 40% of the viewport wide, starting 30% from the left; the right third holds only a huge pale chapter numeral. Chapters are separated by full-width bands of figures on hairlines.

sections.description: Chapter block. A 30px serif question heads a text column about 590px wide, offset 30% from the left. Behind it in the top-right corner sits a chapter numeral roughly 22vw tall in a tint barely darker than the page, cropped by the section's top edge. Body is 18px serif at about 1.8 leading; bold run-in phrases open key paragraphs in place of subheads. No pull quotes, side notes or images inside the text.

Divider band between chapters: a full-width strip about 180px tall in which 10 to 15 drawn figures stand at uneven intervals on a 1px rule, with 120px of empty page above. The number and spacing of figures follow the story (few and scattered early, an evenly spaced orderly line later), so the divider carries part of the argument instead of acting as a spacer.

The ending switches voice. A white rounded promo bar with a blue pill button, then a heavy sans heading with a short grey paragraph and one green button, then a hairline, a mono uppercase label, and four small white cards in a row (thumbnail, mono number, bold title). It is narrower than the page and sits on a different axis from the essay column, so it reads as site furniture attached afterwards.

steal: Turn the subject into the section divider: a frieze of small figures on a hairline, redrawn for each chapter, in place of rules or spacers.
Set one serif family at three far-apart sizes (200px title, 30px heading, 18px body) and mark chapters with a pale 22vw numeral cropped off the corner.
Hold body text to a narrow column offset left of centre and leave the right third empty instead of filling it with sidebars.

references.name: Architecture of Socialist-Era Belgrade
references.idea: A two-colour printed guidebook on screen: signal-red type over greyscale concrete, with one modular display face as the only ornament.
references.hero: Full-bleed greyscale photograph of brutalist housing towers; pale sky fills the top half, concrete the bottom. The title is set over the sky, flush left at a 32px margin, three lines in a wide modular display face at 102px (7.1vw) in flat red, the longest line reaching 92% of the width, leading so tight that the lines almost touch. Under it, one row at 24px: a red one-line descriptor at left, and two paler-red facts right-aligned (an object count and a date range). Top-right, the word 'Index' with a diagonal arrow. No logo, no button, nothing else. Red and grey only.
references.type: IntraNet, a wide modular display face with rounded, notched corners, used only for the title and its footer repeat. Funnel Sans carries the rest: about 50px for the long intro, 40px bold uppercase entry titles, 24px meta, 13px credits. Four sizes, two faces.
references.colour: #f53843 #d1d1d1 #c7c7c7 #777777 #f1a7ab — Strictly red and grey: red text on grey photo or grey paper, then pale grey text on a solid red field for the essay and footer. Photographs are desaturated so nothing breaks the pair.
references.imagery: Contemporary black-and-white architectural photographs of concrete towers and complexes, frontal or looking up, with big skies and visible grain; full-bleed in the hero, full column width and square-cornered in entries.
references.layout: 16 to 32px margins, everything flush left. A long red essay block in very large text, then twenty repeated entry blocks on grey: a two-column header split by a vertical red hairline, a meta row, then a wide photo. 81 screens of the same rhythm.

sections.description: Immediately under the hero photo a solid red field begins with no gap. The essay runs as one full-width column in pale grey sans at roughly 50px with tight leading, about 50 characters per line, paragraphs separated by one blank line, with no headings, pull-quotes or images for several screens. The photo's bottom edge butts straight against the red.

Each building entry sits on light grey paper: a thin red rule across the top, then two columns divided by a vertical red hairline at the 50% mark. Left: the building's name in red bold uppercase at 40px over two lines. Right: its dates in pale red at the same size. Below, a small meta row with 'Credits' and 'Address' labels and values in 13px red, then a full-width greyscale photograph.

Solid red. At the top, two short 13px notes side by side in pale grey occupy the left 60%, a back-to-top link sits far right, and a third note runs beneath. A tall empty red gap follows. Then the full title is repeated in the display face at hero size but in pale grey, flush left, above a single row of small meta: sources link left, font credits centre, city and year right.

steal: Limit the page to one saturated colour and one grey, desaturate all photos, and invert the pair (grey on red) for long reading blocks.
Set the title in a distinctive modular display face directly on the sky area of a photo and repeat it in the footer in the inverse colour.
Put facts in the hero as a right-aligned row of paler-tint figures (count, date range) on the same baseline as the subtitle.

references.name: Vestris
references.idea: Dry title-settlement software wrapped in a calm painted countryside: gouache-style foliage and skies frame the product so paperwork feels pastoral.
references.hero: Cream field. Nav in a ~1150px container: serif-italic wordmark with a compass icon left, three links centred, sign-in and an olive rounded button right. A centred stack begins at 17% height: a small bordered backer badge, then a one-line serif headline at ~6.7vw, its last two words italic, flanked by oversized parentheses pushed about 100px away from the words so the line spans 60% of the width. A three-line grey sans paragraph (~570px) and an olive button follow. From 62% height a sky-painted panel rises, holding a browser-framed app screenshot ~900px wide, cropped by the fold. Painted leafy branches grow in from both viewport edges, overlapping cream and panel.
references.type: Instrument Serif regular at 96px (-0.03em) for headlines, typically one roman line and one italic line; Geist 18px grey for body and 14px for interface text. Section heads sit near 56px. About four sizes; headings are always centred.
references.colour: #f2efe5 #62654e #bcd3e6 #3f5a2a #fafaf8 #2a2a26 — Warm cream ground, olive buttons, charcoal serif type; sky blue and leaf green arrive only through the painted illustrations. Sections stay cream apart from illustrated panels and the landscape footer.
references.imagery: Painterly gouache-style illustrations (foliage, clouds, a bee, a handshake framed as a perforated postage stamp, a farmhouse landscape) combined with clean app screenshots in rounded browser frames sitting on the painted skies.
references.layout: Centred throughout in a ~1150px container: headline, short paragraph, button, then media. Bare cream screens alternate with large rounded sky-painted panels inset about 20px from the viewport edges; three-column card rows hang off the panels. Vertical gaps exceed 150px.

sections.description: A rounded-corner panel inset about 20px from the viewport sides, filled with a soft painted sky and a leaf branch entering bottom-left. Centred inside: a two-line serif heading at ~4vw (roman line, then italic line) and a two-line grey sentence. Three white rounded cards in a row overlap the lower part of the panel, each with a bold sans title and three lines of small copy.

A bare cream screen with a small painted bee inside a faint circle, centred above a two-line serif heading whose first line is roman and second italic. The letters fill from pale grey to charcoal as the reader scrolls (caught mid-word in the capture). A two-line grey sentence sits beneath. Nothing else occupies the viewport.

Three columns. The outer two each hold a centred two-line serif subhead near 28px, four lines of grey copy and a proof line with a small tick icon. The middle column holds a handshake painting cropped as a postage stamp with a perforated white edge, tilted about ten degrees, breaking the row's symmetry of text.

A full-bleed painted landscape (hills, a white farmhouse, a fenced path) about one viewport tall, with a dark green scrim rising from the bottom. Two buttons float over the sky at top centre. The wordmark and a one-line descriptor sit bottom-left, two short link columns bottom-right, and a legal row runs along the base, all in cream.

steal: Widen a short headline by setting it between oversized parentheses spaced far from the words.
Commission one painted illustration style and use it for section backgrounds, spot icons and the footer, with clean interface screenshots sitting on top.
Crop a spot illustration as a perforated postage stamp and tilt it between two text columns to break a three-column row.
